newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Quebrada Blanca in wage talks with workers.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Quebrada Blanca in wage talks with workers.

text.p: Workers and management at Cominco Ltd's Quebrada Blanca mine in northern Chile have not yet reached a wage deal with nine days to go before the current contract expires, general manager James Drake said.

"Negotiations have started and are currently underway. They are proceeding in a semi-constructive sense," Drake told Reuters, adding that it was possible there would be no deal until the very last stage of talks, even in "the last 24 hours."
Quebrada Blanca's current wage contract expires on April 30.

About 70 percent of the mine's workforce of 500 people is unionized, said Drake. The mine produces about 75,000 tonnes of copper in cathodes a year at the mine in northern Chile near the Bolivian border.
